workflow.title: Book Your Appointment
workflow.description: Contact Montreal Dental Care by email or visit us at 8 Montreal Avenue, Leeds to schedule your appointment.

workflow.title: Initial Examination
workflow.description: We'll conduct a full examination with X-rays and diagnosis to understand your dental needs and health.

workflow.title: Personalised Treatment Plan
workflow.description: We'll discuss your options—NHS or private—and recommend the best treatment plan for your individual needs.

workflow.title: Ongoing Care & Support
workflow.description: Receive preventative advice and follow-up care to maintain your dental health and achieve your smile goals.

faqs.question: What's included in an NHS Band 1 appointment?
faqs.answer: An NHS Band 1 appointment (£26.80) includes a full examination, X-rays, diagnosis, advice on preventing further problems, a scale and polish if clinically needed, and preventative care such as fluoride varnish application.

faqs.question: Can I get an emergency appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer emergency dental appointments for £100, which includes full assessment and treatment to address your urgent dental problem.

faqs.question: Do you offer cosmetic treatments?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide a range of cosmetic treatments including tooth whitening from £270, dental implants from £2300, and advanced dermal fillers for aesthetic enhancement.

faqs.question: Are you accepting new NHS patients?
faqs.answer: We currently have no availability for new NHS patients. However, we welcome private patients and can discuss private treatment options with you.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Band 2 and Band 3 NHS treatment?
faqs.answer: Band 2 (£73.50) covers restorative work like fillings and root canals. Band 3 covers everything in Bands 1 and 2 plus laboratory work such as crowns, dentures, and bridges.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can contact Montreal Dental Care by email at montrealdental.leeds@gmail.com or visit us at 8 Montreal Avenue, Leeds, West Yorkshire LS7 4LF.

detailedServices.title: NHS Band 1 Examination & Preventative Care
detailedServices.description: Comprehensive examination with X-rays, diagnosis, and preventative treatments including scale and polish and fluoride varnish application.

detailedServices.title: NHS Band 2 Restorative Treatment
detailedServices.description: Everything in Band 1 plus additional restorative work including fillings, root canal treatment, and tooth extractions.

detailedServices.title: Dental Implants
detailedServices.description: Premium tooth replacement solution using dental implants to restore missing teeth with a natural appearance and function.

detailedServices.title: Tooth Whitening
detailedServices.description: Professional tooth whitening treatment to brighten your smile and remove stains for a more confident appearance.

detailedServices.title: Emergency Dental Appointment
detailedServices.description: Same-day emergency dental care for urgent dental problems including assessment and treatment to relieve pain and address immediate concerns.

detailedServices.title: Advanced Dermal Fillers
detailedServices.description: Professional aesthetic treatments including tear trough enhancement, chin filler, and jawline definition using advanced dermal fillers.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Very professional team and friendly atmosphere. Had my emergency appointment sorted quickly—highly recommend Montreal Dental Care to anyone in Leeds needing urgent dental help.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: Excellent experience with my tooth whitening treatment. The results are fantastic and the staff explained everything clearly. Worth every penny!

reviews.author: Emma L.
reviews.text: Had a routine check-up and scale and polish. The dentist gave me great preventative advice and made me feel completely at ease. Very professional practice.

reviews.author: Michael P.
reviews.text: Consulted about dental implants and received clear, honest advice about my options. The team is knowledgeable and patient-focused. Great dental practice in Leeds.
